lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Uniform grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel longitudinal rows spanning the entire visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal spot rows, creating a lattice-like arrangement where spots serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running parallel to the spine, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-intensity blobs clustered on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant dark, irregular indentation or depressed lesion is visible on the lower left flank, appearing as a shadow-filled void in the lateral surface plane.
